name: chibi_standard
description: Pixel-exact character template extracted from reference sheet 09d46502714b463788ad0eb9a23ae0f9.png (archived as assets/reference_sheet.png). All proportions, colors and part boundaries verified pixel-by-pixel. Three views — front, side, back — each with its own pixel map and its own part_map.

_schema.part_map: Ownership in ABSOLUTE image coords. head_rows owns the whole width of those rows; body owns body_rows minus arm_left_cols/arm_right_cols; legs split leg_rows by leg_split_per_row (one entry per leg_rows value, x <= split -> leg_left, x > split -> leg_right). Every opaque pixel belongs to exactly one part, which is what makes the reconstruction invariant hold by construction.
_schema.part_map_zh: 归属用【绝对图像坐标】。head_rows 整宽归头；body 取 body_rows 减去 arm_left_cols/arm_right_cols；腿按 leg_split_per_row 划分 leg_rows（与 leg_rows 一一对应，x <= 分界归 leg_left，x > 分界归 leg_right）。每个不透明像素只属于一个部件 —— 重建不变量因此构造性成立。

front.note: Legs split at the vertical centre line x15/x16 for every row. The tan/pants colour difference between the two legs is SHADING, not the leg boundary — at x15 the split is symmetric on every row (3/3 at y21, 4/4 at y22-y23, 2/2 below the knee).
front.note_zh: 腿在所有行都按垂直中线 x15/x16 划分。两腿的 tan/pants 色差是【明暗】，不是腿界 —— 取 x15 时每行都对称（y21 为 3/3，y22-y23 为 4/4，膝下 2/2）。

side.note: Side view: the two legs are genuinely different legs (front leg tan, back leg pants), so the split is the COLOUR boundary and it moves with the drawing — x17 at y21-y22 where both thighs are widest, x15 from y23 down. A flat split would hand the front thigh's outer pixels to the back leg, and walk_side rotates the legs, so those pixels would swing with the wrong leg.
side.note_zh: 侧视：两条腿是【真】两条腿（前腿 tan、后腿 pants），所以分界就是颜色边界，且随画面变化 —— y21-y22 两条大腿最宽处取 x17，y23 起取 x15。用统一分界会把前腿外侧像素判给后腿，而 walk_side 会旋转腿，那些像素会跟着错的腿摆。
side.anchors_note: leg_right overrides defaultPivot, which lands on (18,21) because the bbox is skewed left by the flared boot at y30-y31. The hip joint is the centre of the part's TOP edge (y21 spans x18..x21 -> 19.5 -> 19); pivoting there moves the joint row half as much as pivoting at the corner.
side.anchors_note_zh: leg_right 覆盖 defaultPivot —— 后者落在 (18,21)，因为靴子在 y30-y31 向左外扩，把 bbox 拽偏了。髋关节应在部件【顶边】的中点（y21 占 x18..x21 -> 19.5 -> 19）；绕它转，关节处的位移只有绕角落转的一半。

back.note: Back view is structurally identical to the front: same arm columns, and the legs split at the centre line x15/x16 on every row.
back.note_zh: 背视与正面结构完全相同：手臂列一致，腿同样在所有行按中线 x15/x16 划分。
